notes: RSS can double-count shared pages; GPU memory is not added. Short-lived/reparented helpers can escape ps attribution; compare CDP PID inventory. New VT services are temporally attributed, not proven exclusively owned. Host-other CPU includes harness/system work and is never charged to the browser. CSS physical geometry does not establish compositor allocation size or scanout. DOM visibility/focus and transition events do not prove native unoccluded scanout, display wake state or audible device output. Video counters measure submitted/dropped frames, not compositor presentation. No continuous GPU or audio-route probe is made. Decoder evidence, audible output, display state, dropped-frame gate and foreign-work audit require review before comparison. Background flags and page URL blocking are not comprehensive whole-browser egress verification.
evidence_scope: One full browser observation, not a production acceptance gate or a superiority claim.

attribution_review.reason: The measured harness retained CDP PID inventories and ps selection counts, but not ps PID inventories. Exact set membership cannot be reconstructed after exit.
attribution_review.vt_limit: New VT services are selected by appearance since startup, not verified exclusive ownership. Existing VT service work remained host-other.
attribution_review.foreign_work_review: No cargo/rustc/clippy/build-script entries appeared in bounded top-eight host-other rows; not proof that all such activity was absent. WindowServer, WallpaperAerialsExtension, VTDecoderXPCService and other host processes were active.
